critique: Exceptional architectural product photography. The Surf Clock faithfully replicates the vertical rectangular monolith housing, recessed matte navy face, 9 upper radial ticks with a completely blank bottom arc, accurate beach typography, lower semicircular 'WORTH IT?' gauge, and single burnt-orange hands per dial. The rough-hewn coastal travertine plinth against the misty ocean horizon creates a sublime, magazine-grade editorial composition.
